instruction: Office Schedule Metadata From Init Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. Use init_plan.png on the Desktop as the visual reference for the target layout. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Create 1 building story, 4 spaces and 4 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Office-A, Office-B, Conference and Support. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 26 total OS:Surface objects, split into 4 floor surfaces, 4 roof/ceiling surfaces and 18 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 4 Ground, 12 Outdoors and 10 Surface. Do not add any subsurfaces or windows. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 4 ideal-loads air systems, 4 zone HVAC equipment lists, 4 dual-setpoint thermostats, 2 people definitions, 2 lights definitions and 2 electric equipment definitions. For schedule metadata, assign Office-A, Office-B and Conference to an OS:SpaceType named OfficeType whose default schedule set is Office Defaults; assign Support to an OS:SpaceType named SupportType whose default schedule set is Support Defaults. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 16.00 m in X, 12.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 192.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 179.20 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
